title: "Agent-Based Modeling"

<p class="chapter-subtitle">Building a model and learning from simulation experiments</p>

The Agent-Based Modeling module translates an understood social-learning mechanism into an explicit model. It first connects agents, state, rules, interaction, activation, and time to their implementation in Agents.jl. It then moves from a single model run to repeated, reproducible simulation experiments and bounded interpretation.

### Build a Simple Agent-Based Model

Define agents and model properties, initialize a model, express an agent step, advance time, and connect each part of the program to an ABM concept.
